new_findings.title: Invalid FEMA flood-zone geometry in Osborn capture
new_findings.description: Two native NAD83 GeoJSON flood-zone polygons fail ring validity in the bounded Osborn NFHL capture. Originals are preserved and excluded from intersection/area calculations pending source-native and map corroboration.

reviews.next_action: Compare the two invalid polygons with native Esri service geometry and the 2024 annotated map evidence. Investigate representation versus source topology; propose a correction only with evidence and retain a hold meanwhile.
reviews.note: Original coordinates and attributes archived; no automatic repair or parcel clearance. Exact validity diagnostics and source IDs retained in this audit.

reviews.next_action: Resolve TL-F-0026; reconcile the boundary-sensitive neighboring LOMR and amendment coverage before bounded parcel screening. Broader Maine coverage remains unqualified.
reviews.note: Qualified Osborn hazard, availability, panels, revisions and study metadata; verified 2024 LOMR effective date against the original determination and reconciled 1503 captured IDs. Historical 2016 no-SFHA statements are not current clearance. Preserve separate catalog issue/effective clocks.

reviews.next_action: Confirm LUPC treatment of the May 31, 2024 FEMA revision and current Osborn map/amendment history; continue wetland/hydrography and ground-boundary qualification.
reviews.note: FEMA letter revises five Osborn panels and adds mapped hazard areas without revising the 2016 FIS report. This resolves a FEMA evidence dependency but does not establish LUPC legal currency, adoption or parcel applicability. Existing zoning screenings and holds unchanged.
